candidates.disposition_note: A reserved/preparing/prepared task has a unique reservation_token; _update_status requires the captured (task_id, attempt, reservation_token, current_status) in a SQLite transaction, so a late old preparer cannot promote a replaced row. No supported stale-preparation adoption path or justified patch established; inspected source only, no native execution claimed.
